name: New device followed by privilege escalation
input: new_device event followed by a privilege_escalation event for the same user_id.

condition.description: A device_id never previously seen for this user_id appears, and a privilege_escalation event for the same user_id occurs within 15 minutes of that device's first appearance.

evidence_template: Login from previously unseen device {device_id} for user {user_id} at {device_ts}
Privilege escalation ({role_before} -> {role_after}) for user {user_id} at {escalation_ts}, {gap_seconds}s later
false_positives: Legitimate new device (new laptop, phone) combined with a coincidental, unrelated, authorized role change (e.g. approved promotion).
Device fingerprinting false negative — same physical device reported as 'new' due to browser update/reinstall.
